SBCT.description: Suspension Bridge Analysis Control (SBCT). A single-instance control (key is always 1); ANAL_METHOD_TYPE drives which group field applies (INIT uses GROUP_NAME and enables OPT_CONS_HOR/OPT_HANGER sub-objects; OPT uses CABLE_GROUP_SUB_NAME).

NUM_ITR.description: Number of iterations for the suspension bridge analysis.

CONV_TOL.description: Convergence tolerance for the iterative analysis.

ANAL_METHOD_TYPE.description: Analysis method (case-insensitive). INIT = initial equilibrium state analysis; OPT = optimization. Selects which group field is used: INIT -> GROUP_NAME, OPT -> CABLE_GROUP_SUB_NAME.

GROUP_NAME.description: [ANAL_METHOD_TYPE=INIT] Node group to be updated. Must reference an existing group name.

CABLE_GROUP_SUB_NAME.description: [ANAL_METHOD_TYPE=OPT] Cable group to be updated. Must reference an existing group name.

SAG_GROUP_NAME.description: Sag point group. Must reference an existing group name.

OPT_CONS_HOR.description: [ANAL_METHOD_TYPE=INIT] Enable/disable constant horizontal force of cable. When true, CONS_HOR must be provided.

CONS_HOR.description: [ANAL_METHOD_TYPE=INIT && OPT_CONS_HOR=true] Constant horizontal force of cable definition.

CABLE_GROUP_NAME.description: Main cable group. Must reference an existing group name.

HOR_FORCE.description: Horizontal force applied to the main cable group.

OPT_HANGER.description: [ANAL_METHOD_TYPE=INIT] Enable/disable define girder Z-displacement condition. When true, HANGER must be provided.

HANGER_GROUP_NAME.description: Hanger group. Must reference an existing group name.

HANGER_Z_DISP.description: Girder Z-displacement data. Exactly one entry is allowed (handler enforces size == 1).

GIRDER_GROUP_NAME.description: Girder group. Must reference an existing group name; the node list is derived from this group (input ARR_NODE_KEY is ignored by the handler).

DISP_TYPE.description: Target displacement type (case-insensitive). ZERO = all target Z-displacements set to 0 (ARR_Z_DISP ignored); USER = user-supplied ARR_Z_DISP whose length must equal the derived node count.

ARR_NODE_KEY.description: Array of node keys (read-only echo; ignored on POST/PUT since nodes are derived from GIRDER_GROUP_NAME).

ARR_Z_DISP.description: [DISP_TYPE=USER] Array of target Z-displacements, one per node; ignored when DISP_TYPE=ZERO.

SBCT_BASE.description: Load cases to be considered in the analysis. Maximum 15 entries.

LOAD_CASE_NAME.description: Static load case name. Must reference an existing load case.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the load case.
